description.en: The content type of the file.

description.zh: 待上传文件的MD5值。该值必须为待上传文件的实际MD5值，在通过上传URL时会对文件大小进行校验
description.en: The MD5 hash of the file to be uploaded. This value must be the file's actual MD5 hash. The file size is also verified during the upload.

description.zh: 上传文件的文件名。文件名格式可以上传单文件名（例如：1.jpg）或路径格式（例如：dircectory1/1.jpg）
description.en: The name of the file to upload. The filename can be a single file, such as \`1.jpg\`, or include a path, such as \`directory1/1.jpg\`.

description.zh: 待上传文件的实际Byte大小。该值必须为待上传文件的实际Byte大小，在通过上传URL时会对文件大小进行校验
description.en: The actual size of the file in bytes. This value must be the exact size of the file. The file size is verified when you use the upload URL.

descriptions.zh: 获取的URL需使用阿里云OSSSDK进行上传
descriptions.en: You can upload files using the retrieved URL and the Alibaba Cloud OSS software development kit (SDK).
